tin_ore.name: Tin Ore
tin_ore.description: Soft grey stone. Smelted with copper it makes bronze.

silver_ore.name: Silver Ore
silver_ore.description: Pale ore that glints in the seam. Jewellers want it.

gold_nugget.name: Gold Nugget
gold_nugget.description: A heavy, buttery lump from the riverbed.

spirit_iron_ore.name: Spirit-Iron Ore
spirit_iron_ore.description: Dense green-lit ore that hums faintly near a cultivator.

rift_crystal.name: Rift Crystal
rift_crystal.description: Violet crystal that grows where the Rift leaks. Cold to hold and never quite still.

sulfur.name: Sulfur
sulfur.description: Yellow crust from hot springs. Alchemists burn it.

saltpetre.name: Saltpetre
saltpetre.description: White crystalline salt, sharp on the tongue. It makes alchemist's fire bite.

flint.name: Flint
flint.description: Knapped for sparks and arrow tips.

limestone.name: Limestone
limestone.description: Burned for lime, dressed for walls.

marble.name: Marble
marble.description: White stone for halls and statues.

garnet.name: Garnet
garnet.description: Deep red, common in the hill seams.

moonstone.name: Moonstone
moonstone.description: Milky stone with a drifting light.

ruby.name: Ruby
ruby.description: A rich red that catches firelight.

ember_opal.name: Ember Opal
ember_opal.description: Fire-flecked opal found near Emberglass Mere.

spirit_jade.name: Spirit Jade
spirit_jade.description: Jade that keeps a little qi. Cultivators carve it into talismans.

spirit_stone_lesser.name: Lesser Spirit Stone
spirit_stone_lesser.description: A chip of crystallised qi. Cultivators spend these like coin.

spirit_stone.name: Spirit Stone
spirit_stone.description: Crystallised qi the size of a knuckle.

spirit_stone_greater.name: Greater Spirit Stone
spirit_stone_greater.description: A luminous stone; a whole sect's month of cultivation sits in it.

bronze_ingot.name: Bronze Ingot
bronze_ingot.description: Copper and tin. Holds an edge far better than copper.

steel_ingot.name: Steel Ingot
steel_ingot.description: Iron worked with coal until it rings.

fine_steel_ingot.name: Fine Steel Ingot
fine_steel_ingot.description: Folded, quenched and folded again. Blades made of it keep their edge for years.

gold_ingot.name: Gold Ingot
gold_ingot.description: A small bar of gold, stamped by the mint.

spirit_iron_ingot.name: Spirit-Iron Ingot
spirit_iron_ingot.description: Metal that answers qi. Smiths of the sect yards keep the method close.

rift_crystal_ingot.name: Rift-Crystal Ingot
rift_crystal_ingot.description: Spirit-iron fused with Rift crystal. It is never warm.

iron_nails.name: Iron Nails
iron_nails.description: A fistful of nails, bundled with twine.

hinges.name: Iron Hinges
hinges.description: Pair of forged hinges for doors and chests.

scrap_iron.name: Scrap Iron
scrap_iron.description: Bent, rusted bits. Worth melting down.

rivets.name: Rivets
rivets.description: Small iron rivets for armour and belts.

ironwood_log.name: Ironwood Log
ironwood_log.description: Wood so hard it dulls a saw. Takes a steel edge.

spiritwood_log.name: Spiritwood Log
spiritwood_log.description: Trees that grew over old qi-veins. Sap like pale jade.

ironwood_plank.name: Ironwood Plank
ironwood_plank.description: Dense, dark plank that resists axes.

spiritwood_plank.name: Spiritwood Plank
spiritwood_plank.description: A pale plank that faintly glows under moonlight.

bark.name: Oak Bark
bark.description: Tannin-rich bark for the tanner's pit.

resin.name: Pine Resin
resin.description: Sticky amber resin for glue and torches.

bowstring.name: Bowstring
bowstring.description: Waxed cord, strong enough to hold a bow drawn.

boar_hide.name: Boar Hide
boar_hide.description: Thick bristled hide. It turns a knife.

bear_pelt.name: Bear Pelt
bear_pelt.description: A big brown pelt, heavy and warm.

troll_hide.name: Troll Hide
troll_hide.description: Knobbled green-grey hide that slowly knits itself closed.

wyvern_hide.name: Wyvern Hide
wyvern_hide.description: Scaled, supple and nearly proof against steel.

hardened_leather.name: Hardened Leather
hardened_leather.description: Boiled and waxed until it rings.

wyvern_leather.name: Wyvern Leather
wyvern_leather.description: Wyvern hide worked into supple, scaled leather.

fur_trim.name: Fur Trim
fur_trim.description: Strips of fur for collars and cuffs.

sinew.name: Sinew
sinew.description: Dried animal sinew. Stitches and strings.

tallow.name: Tallow
tallow.description: Rendered fat for candles, salve and boots.

silk_cocoon.name: Silk Cocoon
silk_cocoon.description: Imported from Shenlu. Unwinds into fine thread.

silk_cloth.name: Bolt of Silk
silk_cloth.description: Smooth silk that shrugs off a cold wind.

spider_silk.name: Spider Silk
spider_silk.description: Sticky-strong web strands from giant spiders.

spidersilk_cloth.name: Spidersilk Cloth
spidersilk_cloth.description: Light as breath and hard to tear.

spirit_silk_cocoon.name: Spirit-Silk Cocoon
spirit_silk_cocoon.description: Spun by moths that feed on qi-blossom.

spirit_silk.name: Spirit Silk
spirit_silk.description: Cloth that holds qi like a cup holds water.

rift_silk_thread.name: Rift Silk Thread
rift_silk_thread.description: Threads drawn from the Rift's weaving. They move on their own.

riftweave_cloth.name: Riftweave Cloth
riftweave_cloth.description: Woven Rift thread; it darkens when watched.

dye_red.name: Madder Red Dye
dye_red.description: A pot of dye made from madder root.

dye_blue.name: Woad Blue Dye
dye_blue.description: A pot of dye made from woad leaves.

dye_yellow.name: Weld Yellow Dye
dye_yellow.description: A pot of dye made from weld flowers.

dye_brown.name: Walnut Brown Dye
dye_brown.description: A pot of dye made from walnut husks.

dye_black.name: Oak-Gall Black Dye
dye_black.description: A pot of dye made from oak galls.

dye_green.name: Moss Green Dye
dye_green.description: A pot of dye made from nettle and alum.

feverfew.name: Feverfew
feverfew.description: Bitter white-flowered herb. Breaks a fever.

nettle.name: Nettle
nettle.description: Stings the hand, cures the blood. Also makes cord.

moonpetal.name: Moonpetal
moonpetal.description: Opens only at night. Steeped for sharp eyes in the dark.

emberleaf.name: Emberleaf
emberleaf.description: Red leaf that warms the belly.

frostmint.name: Frostmint
frostmint.description: Cold, clean mint. Numbs and cools.

ghostcap.name: Ghostcap
ghostcap.description: Pale mushroom from graveyards. Quiets the body and dulls the mind.

bloodmoss.name: Bloodmoss
bloodmoss.description: Red moss from the wolf-runs. Knits flesh.

sunroot.name: Sunroot
sunroot.description: Sweet root that keeps a walker going.

wolfsbane.name: Wolfsbane
wolfsbane.description: Purple hood, deadly to handle bare-handed. Wards off beasts.

nightshade.name: Nightshade
nightshade.description: Black berries. A little numbs; a lot kills.

redcap.name: Redcap
redcap.description: Red mushroom with a peppery bite.

spirit_ginseng.name: Spirit Ginseng
spirit_ginseng.description: A root with a man's shape. Fifty years old at least.

ember_blossom.name: Ember Blossom
ember_blossom.description: Petals glow at dusk. Found on the slopes above the Mere.

qi_blossom.name: Qi Blossom
qi_blossom.description: Golden blossom that drinks qi from the air.

ashroot.name: Ashroot
ashroot.description: Grey root growing on burnt ground.

orc_tusk.name: Orc Tusk
orc_tusk.description: Heavy tusk, carved by the Tuskridge clan.

bone_shard.name: Bone Shard
bone_shard.description: Brittle shard from a risen skeleton.

bone_dust.name: Bone Dust
bone_dust.description: Ground bone. Good for tonics and worse things.

venom_sac.name: Venom Sac
venom_sac.description: A swollen gland. Handle with gloves.

bear_claw.name: Bear Claw
bear_claw.description: Curved and thick as a thumb.

troll_blood.name: Troll Blood
troll_blood.description: Sluggish green blood. A few drops close a wound.

troll_tooth.name: Troll Tooth
troll_tooth.description: Yellow and as long as a finger.

wyvern_fang.name: Wyvern Fang
wyvern_fang.description: A fang as long as a dagger.

wyvern_scale.name: Wyvern Scale
wyvern_scale.description: Hard, light scale. Smiths pay handsomely.

wyvern_wing_membrane.name: Wyvern Wing Membrane
wyvern_wing_membrane.description: Thin, tough skin from a wyvern wing.

ghost_essence.name: Ghost Essence
ghost_essence.description: Cold fluid that clings to the hand.

ash_residue.name: Ash Residue
ash_residue.description: Grey ash with a pulse of warmth in it. Left by the Ash-Ghosts.

rift_dust.name: Rift Dust
rift_dust.description: Glittering dust left when Rift creatures die.

boar_tusk_fine.name: Prime Boar Tusk
boar_tusk_fine.description: A long curved tusk. Good ivory.

hornet_honey.name: Wild Honeycomb
hornet_honey.description: Sticky comb from a wild hive.

minor_core.name: Minor Beast Core
minor_core.description: A pea of hardened magicules from a small beast.

lesser_core.name: Lesser Beast Core
lesser_core.description: A core the size of a walnut, warm to the touch.

beast_core.name: Beast Core
beast_core.description: A strong core from an apex beast. Alchemists and cultivators both bid.

greater_core.name: Greater Beast Core
greater_core.description: A fist-sized core; light pulses inside.

rift_core.name: Rift Core
rift_core.description: A heart of Rift crystal from a creature that should not exist.

essence_fire.name: Fire Essence
essence_fire.description: A vial of condensed fire magicules.

essence_water.name: Water Essence
essence_water.description: A vial of condensed water magicules.

essence_wind.name: Wind Essence
essence_wind.description: A vial of condensed wind magicules.

essence_earth.name: Earth Essence
essence_earth.description: A vial of condensed earth magicules.

essence_lightning.name: Lightning Essence
essence_lightning.description: A vial of condensed lightning magicules.

lime.name: Quicklime
lime.description: Burned limestone. Mix with sand for mortar.

mortar.name: Mortar
mortar.description: Lime and sand for laying stone.

glass.name: Glass Pane
glass.description: A clear pane, blown and flattened.

wax.name: Beeswax
wax.description: Golden wax, good for candles and sealing.

flux.name: Smith's Flux
flux.description: Borax and sand. Cleans a weld.

ash.name: Wood Ash
ash.description: Lye and lime for soap, dye and tanning.

pottery_jug.name: Clay Jug
pottery_jug.description: A fired jug with a cork stopper.

candle.name: Tallow Candle
candle.description: A lit hour in a stick.
